en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a European town square. The image shows a broad cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑storey historic townhouses with arcades and ornate facades. In the center distance stands a lamppost; a few people and children are scattered around the open space. On the right edge are shopfronts with signage, including one for a business named Paul Grossmann. A building on the corner carries the sign 'Hotel Huppert'. At the top left of the card, handwritten text reads 'Radetur g. Markt'. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century German town market square scene.
